seo.title: TablePro for iPhone and iPad
seo.description: A free database client for iPhone and iPad. Connect to MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Oracle and more over SSH or TLS, then browse, edit and query tables.

hero.title: TablePro for iPhone and iPad
hero.lead: Connect over SSH or TLS, then browse, edit and query your databases from your phone or tablet.
hero.requirement: Free, with no in-app purchases. Requires {requirement}.

databases.title: Databases
databases.syncedOnly: {engines} connections open when they come from your Mac, through iCloud Sync or a .tablepro file.
databases.files: SQLite works on a copy of the file you pick. DuckDB opens a file in place or runs in memory.

bands.title: Connect securely
text: Tunnel through SSH with a password or a private key, and trust the server’s host key on first connect. Set TLS per connection, with certificate checks and client certificates where the database supports them. Passwords and pasted keys stay in the Keychain.

bands.title: Browse and edit
text: Read rows as cards, sort, search and filter with AND or OR, and tap a foreign key to see the row it points to. Edit a value or set it to NULL, then confirm the save. Insert and delete rows, or truncate and drop a table. Editing or deleting a row needs a primary key.

bands.title: Run queries
text: Write SQL with syntax highlighting, then run or stop it. Share results as JSON, CSV or INSERT statements. Results hold up to {results} rows, and History keeps your last {history} queries on the device. A Live Activity follows a running query on the Lock Screen.

bands.title: Safe Mode
text: Give each connection a level: {levels}. Confirm Writes asks before a statement changes data, and Read-Only blocks it. A statement the app can’t classify counts as a write. Face ID or Touch ID can lock the app on launch and after Auto-Lock.

bands.title: Shortcuts and widgets
text: Open a connection from Siri, Shortcuts, a Quick Connect widget or Spotlight. <ui>Add Rows to Table</ui> inserts JSON or CSV without opening the app. Actions follow the connection’s Safe Mode level and don’t run while the device is locked.

bands.title: With your Mac
text: Turn on iCloud Sync to share connections, groups and tags with your Mac through your own iCloud account. Passwords sync only with Sync Passwords on, and the Mac needs Pro or Team to sync. With sync on, Handoff picks up an open table on the other device.

items.title: What stays on the Mac
text: The AI assistant, the MCP server and driver plugins are in TablePro for Mac, not in this app. So are saved queries, autocomplete, EXPLAIN and ER diagrams. Compare & Sync, Query Insights, Result Charts and Data Rewind are there too, with file import and export and backups. So are SSH jump hosts, Windows authentication and Redis key browsing.

items.title: On iPad
text: Use any orientation and several windows with Stage Manager or Split View. Keyboard shortcuts switch tabs, search and run a query.

items.title: Privacy
text: Nothing goes to TablePro unless you turn on Share Usage Data, a daily report with no hostnames, usernames, passwords, queries or rows.

items.title: Open source
text: The app is open source under the AGPLv3, in the <source>same repository</source> as the Mac app.

closing.title: Get TablePro for iPhone and iPad
closing.text: Install it from the App Store, then open the Chinook sample database to look around.
